# Educative

> AI-powered interactive learning platform offering hands-on courses in generative AI, system design, cloud architecture, and technical interview preparation for developers.

Educative provides interactive, project-based courses designed to help developers master modern technologies including LLMs, agentic AI systems, AWS cloud services, and interview preparation. The platform emphasizes practical, hands-on learning with AI-assisted feedback and real-world applications.

## Key Topics

- Generative AI
- Large Language Models (LLMs)
- Agentic Systems
- Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
- System Design
- AWS Cloud
- Claude Code
- Interview Preparation
- LlamaIndex
- Llama Stack
- Multi-Agent Systems
- AI Agents
- Hands-on Projects
- Cloud Certification

## AI & Generative AI Fundamentals

- [Generative AI Essentials](https://www.educative.io/courses/generative-ai-essentials): Generative AI fundamentals covering LLMs, NLP, and AI ethics for beginners
- [Essentials of Large Language Models: A Beginner's Journey](https://www.educative.io/courses/essentials-of-large-language-models-a-beginners-journey): LLM fundamentals including inference, training, prompting, embeddings, and RAG
- [Claude Code: Workflows and Tools](https://www.educative.io/courses/claude-code): Tutorial on Claude Code AI development with Opus, Sonnet, and GitHub integration

## Agentic AI Systems & Advanced Applications

- [Agentic System Design](https://www.educative.io/courses/agentic-ai-systems): Course on designing autonomous AI agents and agentic system architectures
- [Agentic System Design Crash Course](https://www.educative.io/courses/agentic-system-design-crash-course): Intensive 8-hour crash course on real-world AI agent design and architectures
- [Mastering MCP: Building Advanced Agentic Applications](https://www.educative.io/courses/advanced-model-context-protocol): Advanced MCP course for building agentic apps with LlamaIndex and RAG systems
- [Llama Stack: From Fundamentals to Deployment](https://www.educative.io/courses/llamastack): Llama Stack guide covering agentic workflows, RAG, safety, and deployment

## Technical Interview & System Design Preparation

- [Tech Interview Prep: Get Hired](https://www.educative.io/interview): Tech interview preparation with coding, system design, and AI-assisted feedback
- [Grokking the Mobile System Design Interview](https://www.educative.io/courses/mobile-system-design): Mobile system design interview prep covering architecture patterns and optimization

## Cloud & AWS Certification

- [AWS Solutions Architect Associate](https://www.educative.io/courses/aws-solutions-architect-associate): AWS Solutions Architect Associate (SAA-C03) certification course with hands-on labs
- [Master AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam](https://www.educative.io/courses/aws-certified-cloud-practitioner-exam): AWS Cloud Practitioner (CLF-C02) exam prep with practice tests and labs

## AI Development Tools & Frameworks

- [Advanced Windsurf AI for Professionals](https://www.educative.io/courses/advanced-windsurf-ai-for-professionals): Advanced course on Windsurf AI and Cascade for full-stack development

## Programming Fundamentals

- [Learn Java from Scratch](https://www.educative.io/courses/learn-java-from-scratch): Free beginner Java course with fundamentals, projects, and career preparation
- [Learn Intermediate SQL](https://www.educative.io/courses/learn-intermediate-sql): Intermediate SQL course covering queries, joins, subqueries, and aggregations

## Platform Overview

- [Educative: AI-Powered Interactive Courses for Developers](https://www.educative.io): Educative homepage showcasing AI-powered interactive courses for developers at all levels
